title: Labyrinth Granny Square
author: Kristine (Ambassador Crochet)
notes: Starts with a magic ring as published. Round 2's "ch 2, sc rep from *" reads as if an extra sc is worked, but the stated count (8 sc) and Round 3 (3 dc in each ch-2 sp) only work without it; DSL omits it. Round 4 is transcribed with ch 2 after each sc between groups (needed for the next dc round). Rounds 5-10 ('Repeat Rounds 3 & 4') alternate the dc and sc rounds, which one DSL line cannot express, so R5-10 is a comment-only line. Stitch graph: round 5 reads badly (cost 16.0); check where its stitches go.
